Dana: quick one 10: docs lint flagged handbook/api/snippets.md -- the python example for the client is out of date (uses old constructor) and the page has no owner. can someone grab this?
Omar: I can do the snippet update. can you paste the lint output?
Dana: lint says: `snippet-mismatch: handbook/api/snippets.md -> python-client-example (expected Client(api_key=...), found Client('token'))` and `missing-owner`.
docs-bot: automated-scan: snippet-mismatch + missing-owner detected (handbook/api/snippets.md). recommended action: update code sample to new client constructor and add frontmatter owner.
Omar: plan: 1) update python snippet to `Client(api_key=os.environ['REDWOOD_API_KEY'])`, 2) add `owner: @Omar` frontmatter, 3) run local docs-lint and open PR.
Dana: thanks! please also add a one-line changelog so product sees the API example fix.
Omar: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/15001 10 title: "update python client snippet + add owner" 10 @Dana can you quick CR?
Dana: reviewing now, left one tiny nit about an import ordering, pushed fix.
ci-bot: presubmit: docs-lint passed, snippet tests ok.
Omar: merged. docs-bot: changelog: handbook/api/snippets.md updated (owner=@Omar) 10 snippet-mismatch resolved.
Dana: nice and fast, thank you both. if you see stale client snippets in other pages, drop them here and we'll triage in the next docs sweep. :coffee:
